name: Prologue
summary: The opening mission for Lucia.
body: PowerPyx counts it as the 1st main mission of the game.
GTABase's story list has it as mission 1, in Prologue.
Eurogamer says an inmate called Yolanda sits stuck on a crossword in the opening cell block, and talking to her lets Lucia offer an answer for the planet of love.
Eurogamer says the choices are Venus, Uranus and Mars, that Venus is correct and earns her thanks, and that wrong answers only change the dialogue.
Eurogamer calls the prison Leonida Penitentiary, while the app's facts give the location as Hamlet Prison.
GTABase names the prison Hamlet Correctional and says the flashback police chase is scripted: it cannot be escaped, and the game returns to the counsellor's office on its own after a while.

IGN's walkthrough says Cal offers it by text in Chapter 1, that it is missable, and that it has four search areas; selling the packages pays $2,720 at Brian's Lockup or $3,400 at Donnie's Trailer.
IGN recommends finishing it before Clear Skies, since afterwards only one place is left to sell to, and it pays less.
Eurogamer calls this job Donnie's Packages and says Cal texts four new package locations after the first package is delivered and the BuckMe account is set up.

Eurogamer places the packages in the Thorpe Adventures theme park (in a hut left of the entrance), two on an alligator-covered island in Pelican Valley, two at a beach cove and a broken jetty in the Recreation Area, and one in a burnt shack in the Burnt Wetland Homes area.
Eurogamer warns that the packages count as a grab bag, so they are lost if you are arrested or killed, and says they can go to Brian's lockup or Donnie's trailer.

facts.reward: No direct reward; the recovered goods can be sold to a fence

name: Steal Vehicles for Moses
summary: Repeatable car deliveries to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn, open after the Chapter 2 mission Moses; each one counts as an optional task.
body: PowerPyx's 100% guide says vehicles can be fenced after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), and that at first only cars without trackers can be delivered, to Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn.
PowerPyx says cars with Standard Trackers can later, in Chapter 3, be delivered to any Pay 'n' Spray instead.
PowerPyx's 100% guide says each car delivery for Moses adds one to the 100 Optional Tasks requirement, and that fenced vehicles count toward the $200,000 Vehicles Fenced requirement.
PowerPyx's Strangers & Freaks page lists it under Moses in Chapter 2 without marking it as counting toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy, and still had no separate page for it.

PowerPyx says the job opens after Daily Driver, can be played as Lucia or Jason, and pays per car plus a bonus for delivering it in good condition; Moses sends new targets only after the earlier ones are delivered.

PowerPyx lists the six cars and payouts in order: Declasse Yosemite 1500 on Bastion St, south-west Port Gellhorn, being towed away ($1,850); Karin Futo in a lockup at the Draper Island Docks ($1,500); Annis Hellion in a driveway on Orchard Avenue, south Port Gellhorn ($1,400); BF Bandito driven by a group in Buckskin Swamp, south-east Kelly County ($3,350); Declasse Vamos in a shed north-east of Grayson ($4,200); Western Nightblade at the Final Chapter gang site in Ambrosia ($6,310).
PowerPyx says the Vamos shed opens with keypad code 2727, shown on signs inside the nearby trailer, and that the Bandito has one seat.
PowerPyx says the questline continues with Collect Moses' Gift.

PC Gamer says Moses wants older, low-profile cars, usually pays from one to a few thousand dollars each, often says where the cars he wants are, and will not take another car for a while after each sale.
PC Gamer says Randy, the car buyer from Chapter 3, pays much more because he wants flashier high-end cars.

facts.reward: $1,400 to $6,310 per car plus a condition bonus
